reviews.text:
I’ve been using this product for a while, and I’m very satisfied with the results. The texture is pleasant and easy to apply, and it absorbs well without feeling heavy or sticky. After regular use, my skin feels smoother, softer, and more hydrated. I also noticed that my overall complexion looks healthier and more refreshed.

The packaging is convenient and easy to use, making it a great addition to my daily skincare routine. Although everyone’s skin type is different, this product worked well for me and met my expectations. I would definitely consider purchasing it again and would recommend it to anyone looking for a reliable skincare product.
reviews.zh:
我已經用咗呢個產品一段時間，對效果好滿意。質地舒服，容易塗搽，吸收得好又唔會覺得厚重或者黏笠。持續用咗一段時間之後，我覺得皮膚滑咗、軟咗，亦更加保濕。我仲留意到成體膚色睇落健康同有精神咗。

包裝方便易用，係我每日護膚程序嘅好幫手。雖然人人膚質唔同，但呢個產品啱我用，亦達到我嘅期望。我一定會再買，亦推薦畀任何想搵可靠護膚品嘅人。

reviews.text: This is such a cute lip balm, I’m glad I snagged it when I had the chance! it reminds me of early 2000s lip balms and glosses, where the packaging was fun and cute. Love!
reviews.zh: 呢支 lip balm 真係超靚，好彩俾我撞到！令我想起千禧年初嘅 lip balm 同唇彩，嗰陣時嘅包裝得意又好玩。好鍾意！

reviews.text: The packaging of this lip balm is very beautiful, and the texture is very pleasant. For my daughter, the scent was a bit too intense, but everyone has their own taste. Overall, I recommend it.
reviews.zh: 呢支唇膏嘅包裝好靚，質地都好舒服。對我個女嚟講，氣味有少少太濃，但各人口味都唔同。整體嚟講，我推薦呢支。

reviews.text: The packaging is so cute and I love the glittery balm. It’s pretty good at hydrating my lips, but I wish the texture was a little smoother and the scent stronger (for the My Melody Plum Soda one).
reviews.zh: 包裝超得意，我好鍾意閃閃嘅膏體。保濕效果幾好，但希望質地可以滑少少，香味可以再強啲（My Melody Plum Soda 嗰支）。

reviews.text: Pretty good.The color is light and it's way easier to not break than the other one.I suggest getting this one over the karami, one, even though they're both super cute.It's very good to like just plan your desk, but it feels lower quality than some of the other products from the line.Personally, I would still buy it, but just do be warned that if you twist it up all the way it can break.I love the soda pout packaging, though, and I think that bottle is just so unique and epic. It's sheer so it's perfect for students.
reviews.zh: 幾好。顏色好淺，而且比起另一支冇咁易斷。我建議揀呢支多過嗰支 karami 款，雖然兩支都超得意。淨係擺喺書枱度都幾靚，但感覺上比其他同系列嘅產品冇咁有質素。我自己都仲會買嘅，不過要提提大家，如果轉到最出可能會斷。我就好鍾意 soda pout 嘅包裝，覺得個樽真係好特別好正。佢係通透嘅，所以好啱學生用。

reviews.text:
it's a really nice lip balm with a subtle shimmer and color to it
the packaging is also truly adorable!
the only complaint i have is that it has this absolutely god awful grape soda smell that is so strong it makes my nose hurt lol
there's no taste but that first whiff packs a punch
reviews.zh:
呢支 lip balm 真係好正，有少少閃粉同淡淡嘅顏色
包裝都真係超級得意！
唯一要彈嘅係佢有種勁難聞嘅提子汽水味，濃到我個鼻都痛 lol
冇味道嘅，但一打開就好勁

reviews.text: The packaging is super cute and the grape soda scent is nice, but the balm itself isn’t very long-lasting or moisturizing. It gives a light shine at first, but I find it wears off pretty quickly and doesn’t keep my lips hydrated for long. Good for the aesthetic, but not the best if you need real moisture.
reviews.zh: 包裝超靚，提子汽水味都幾好聞，但唇膏本身唔算持久，保濕都一般。開頭有少少光澤，但好快就甩，嘴唇都保濕唔到好耐。睇樣就 OK，但如果要真正保濕就唔算最好。

reviews.text:
So Cute I Can’t Even Use It!

I got the AMUSE [MY MELODY & KUROMI EDITION] Sparkle Soda Lip Balm [KUROMI] 02 Grape Soda, and oh my gosh it’s too cute to use!
 I just want to look at it (or maybe eat it, honestly 😂).

 The packaging is adorable beyond words, and this AMUSE x Sanrio collab is everything I ever wanted.

The scent? Delicious. It smells exactly like sweet grape soda fun, nostalgic, and totally addictive. I swear, I want to take this to the grave with me. 💜🍇✨

If you love cute things and yummy scents, this lip balm is an absolute must have (even if you can’t bring yourself to actually use it!).
reviews.zh:
太得意根本唔捨得用！

我買咗 AMUSE [MY MELODY & KUROMI EDITION] Sparkle Soda Lip Balm [KUROMI] 02 Grape Soda，天呀真係太得意唔捨得用！
我淨係想望住佢（老實講可能想食埋佢😂）。

包裝得意到冇嘢可以形容，AMUSE x Sanrio 嘅 crossover 真係我想要嘅一切。

氣味？好正。聞落就係甜提子汽水嘅味道，懷舊又令人上癮。我發誓，我想帶住佢入棺材。💜🍇✨

如果你鍾意得意嘢同好味嘅氣味，呢支 lip balm 係必買之選（即使你最後唔捨得用！）。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
